title: TP-Link Archer BE700 BE15000 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 Router or Deco BE65-5G Wi-Fi 7 Gateway $239 Delivered @ ARC Online Everyday Market
body:
Deal: TP-Link Archer BE700 BE15000 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 Router or Deco BE65-5G Wi-Fi 7 Gateway $239 Delivered @ ARC Online Everyday Market

[Gavy1370] Wifi 7 and triband fantastic deal not to be missed
[videoman] Anyone ever heard of this "ARC Online" before?
[cowboydev] Arc computers rebranded, reviews are pretty bad if you care
[linkii] Yes, they've been around since forever. They were one of the og computer parts stores.
They use to have shops in Parramatta, Chatswood for over 20yrs which has closed down. Looks like they are in Silverwater now.
[zacsg1] That's what I use, zero problems and good WiFi coverage over a four bedroom house.
[Spendmore] Yeah less powerful than 2 and not as supported in the community.
[Nvu] Im waiting for flint 4, just because i prefer to customise the settings in the much better firmware, but if u dont bother with that then this is very good deal.
i would definitely get this myself if i didnt already have a good enough router.
[Ooops] I went with Flint 2 the other day. VPN speeds are 900mbps.
I think 3 has lower hardware specs.
[RichardF89] thanks bought one. finger crossed for what I will receive.
$769.08 from the seller's own website
https://www.arconline.com.au/tp-link-archer-be700-be15000-tr…
[Bargainendorphins] I use this router. It requires the occasional restart and while the coverage is good, it's not great. Overall though I would recommend, best router I've used in recent years. I have a 500Mbps plan and get between 350-450Mbps on WiFi from my work desk (which is around 10m from the router through plasterboard).
[dangerdanger] I have a lower spec deco unit. It can be scheduled to reboot (I have mine reboot every night at 0200).
More > System > Reboot schedule
Can this unit do the same?
[JMxoxo] I have two of these, one as an eth backhaul mesh and they are great. I have had them for about a year now. I can, for the most part (dependant on age of device) get gigabit on wifi in most areas of the house and use them with a ps portal a bit too and it’s buttery smooth.
I had a Ubiquiti alien previously and that is archaic in comparison.
[soupratt] So if I get 2 or 3 of these they can me "meshed" easily ?
[JMxoxo] Yeah for sure and funnily enough their system is called “EasyMesh” https://www.tp-link.com/au/easymesh/
[donman92] How does this compare to the ASUS TUF Gaming BE3600? Dual band and not fully wifi7 but I've had bad luck with TP Link..
[Nvu] This for sure, the 6ghz and wifi 7 makes it heaps better, although the firmware of the asus is better, but most people dont mess with a lot of the settings on router anyways so this is great deal for most people
[donman92] I added some random $15 mortar and pestle with GET25. Worst case I'll likely get the herb smasher free.
[AdosHouse] No way this is getting honoured. I'd love it, but I'm not wasting my time.
[Kazusa] Tbh it’s the thrill of the game, eventually you get a deal that isn’t cancelled (though 95% of them get cancelled lol)
I’ll never forget the deal where Amazon honoured 16tb hdd’s for $250 each
[pr0d1gy] There's TP-Link Deco BE68 Wi-Fi 7 3 pack for $469 too!
Comes out to be ~$368 with delivery after cashback.
[JoeBogan] Thanks mate I grabbed this one, I’m hoping this is true Tri band!
[Ipodisclassic] I ordered this, hoping it gets delivered. Also, this is my first time trying to get cashback for something and I wanted to ask. I made a shopback account and opened everyday market from the link on their website. I then completed the transaction and paid for it with a VISA card all in the same tab (also disabled my adblocker). Is there anything else that I need to do, or I just wait for the cashback to get tracked then sent to me on my sb account?
[donman92] You'll get a notification form shopback if done right. If not, record the order number payment etc and submit request
[Ipodisclassic] I used the $25 promo code on Everyday Market so shopback says the cashback amount is $0. Fml.
[CBrads4] Purchased this router earlier in the year and I’ve been really happy with it. Good signal strength, no issues to report so far.
[8millpond] Got one inline. didnt use code as shopback will reject. but it looks like a price error
[ltzJack] Bought 2 and hope it would dispatch, I guess it wouldn't.
Cashback tracked in 10 mins
[freefall101] There are tonnes of items on their page that are $239. Looks like someone has screwed up.
No way it'll be honoured, but good luck to those trying.
[reece8] hopefully store had a truck of tplink routers that fell off the back and got loaded into their warehouse for quick sale! :D
[donman92] BIGW still up:
https://www.bigw.com.au/product/tp-link-archer-be700-be15000…
[reece8] I'm gonna pair this for short range 6ghz 320mhz speed and my flint 3 for 6ghz 320mhz coverage.
[Ooops] Flint 2 definitely.
I went from Asus to Deco to Flint. So much better experience for me.
[cmoddoo] Everyone said get Flint 2, so I did and very happy with it so far.
